header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present on behalf of the petitioner nor any intimation is received.
This petition was filed in the year 2021 and lastly fixed in Court on
21.04.2021. Thereafter, no efforts have been made by the counsel for
body: petitioner to fix the matter in Court and to proceed with the matter. It appears that counsel for petitioner has lost interest in the matter. Accordingly, this petition is dismissed for non-prosecution.
